meta.name: caveman-stats
meta.description: Show real token usage and estimated savings for the current session. Reads directly from the Claude Code session log — no AI estimation. Triggers on /caveman-stats. Output is injected by the mode-tracker hook; the model itself does not compute the numbers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 实时查看本次会话的token用量和节省成本
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想实时掌握当前会话的token用量与成本节省。
copy.tagline_en: See real token usage and estimated savings for the current session.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to keep an eye on how many tokens your session uses and how much it saves.

howto.what: 安装后,在 Claude Code 里输入 /caveman-stats,界面会直接显示本次会话的真实 token 用量和估算节省金额,数字来自会话日志而非 AI 估算。输出还会附上规则开销与净节省,若净节省为负会说明并建议关闭。
howto.when: 当你在 Claude Code 会话中输入斜杠命令 /caveman-stats 时触发,统计结果立即出现。

say.note: 立即显示本次会话的真实 token 用量。
数字来自会话日志,非 AI 估算。

say.text: 再跑一次 /caveman-stats,查看规则开销
say.note: 会显示估计的规则成本与净节省。

howto.what_en: Typing /caveman-stats shows real token usage and savings estimates read from the session log (not AI). It also adds rule-overhead and net lines; negative net is reported plainly with a suggestion to disable caveman.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you type /caveman-stats in a Claude Code session; stats appear immediately.

say_en.note: Shows real token usage and savings instantly.
Also shows rule overhead; negative net suggests disabling.
Displays per-turn rule cost and net savings.
